title: Mucho gusto
subtitle: Meeting {partner}’s parents
scene: {partner} opens the door. {mom} and {dad} are waiting in the living room.

lines.note: Él es… = This is… (for a man). Introductions use the verb ser.

lines.en: Hi, {me}! We finally get to meet you.
Nice to meet you, ma’am. Delighted.

culture.title: Saludos
culture.text: Greet each person in the room, one by one: a handshake or a light kiss on the right cheek, plus a few words. Skipping someone can come across as cold.

lines.en: Nice to meet you, sir. How are you?
lines.note: ¿Cómo está? (usted) vs ¿Cómo estás? (tú). One letter shows respect.

lines.es: Muy bien, gracias. {partner} habla mucho de ustedes.
lines.en: Very well, thanks. {partner} talks about you all a lot.
lines.note: Ustedes = you all. In Mexico it’s the only plural “you”, formal or casual.

lines.en: Aw, how sweet! Come in, come in.
